children: EOG Resources named Jeffrey Hibbard as its next chief financial officer, effective Jan. 1, 2027.
Hibbard succeeds Ann Janssen, who plans to retire from EOG in 2027, the crude oil and natural gas exploration company said Thursday.
Hibbard has been EOG's senior vice president of finance since joining the company in 2025. Hibbard previously worked for Morgan Stanley for more than 20 years in various investment banking roles.

Janssen has been EOG's CFO since 2024, and has worked at the company for more than 30 years after joining a predecessor company in 1995. She will serve as an advisor to allow for the transition of her responsibilities before retirement, EOG said.
